company.name: DriveWealth
company.shortDescription: DriveWealth is a visionary technology company that empowers more than 100 partners around the world.
company.description:
DriveWealth, the global fintech investment rail and pioneer of fractional equities trading, is a visionary technology company that empowers more than 100 partners around the world to engage
their customers by placing the markets in the palm of their hands. We believe the future is fractional, transactional, and mobile. Every mobile device should be a gateway to accessing
investing and savings products, services, advice, and assistance for global citizens of all ages, wealth stages, and levels of financial expertise. DriveWealth’s consultative support and cloud based, modern technology platform allow partners to seamlessly offer branded investing experiences to drive customer acquisition, loyalty, retention, and revenue growth.

productsAndServices.description: Institutional trading infrastructure for order routing, clearing, custody, stock loan, liquidity access, and execution of securities transactions.

aiResearchSummary.text: DriveWealth is researching methods for executing fractional-based buy or sell orders, as described in 'How Fractional Share Orders are Executed.' The abstract details a process where a processing unit receives a fractional share component of an order, queues it, and manages execution, including notional-based buy orders. This work highlights DriveWealth’s focus on developing systems for efficient handling and processing of fractional share transactions.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series D round raised $450,000,000, or 82.92% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $28,448,413 to $2,850,000,000, a 100.18x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
